svg.title: The convergence ladder, settled beside unsettled
svg.desc: Two five-rung convergence ladders for the same schematic target local day, newest run first, each rung labelled with its run reference time, its leadHours to the day's local-noon anchor (19 to 67 hours), and its vote. Left, a settled day: the newest three rungs vote window with magnitudes 1480, 1370, and 1520 m above launch; spreadM = 1520 - 1370 = 150 m, within magnitudeBandM 300, so settled is true. Right, an unsettled day: window rungs at 1980 and 1420 m and a quiet rung at 990 m of depth give spreadM = 1980 - 990 = 990 m, over the band, so settled is false. In both ladders the settled band encloses only the newest minRuns = 3 rungs; an older rung votes outside the band, and the oldest rung is an abstention with the stated reason outOfHorizon and no magnitude.
